name: Inazuma Eleven® GO: Shadow
description:
Summon up your fighting spirit as Raimon Jr. High takes to the pitch again! New footie stars, new moves and a whole new adventure’s kicking off in Inazuma Eleven GO: Light and Inazuma Eleven GO: Shadow on Nintendo 3DS family systems!

So, if you’re a football fan and reckon you’ve got what it takes to put together the very best team from over a thousand players, sign up with Inazuma Eleven GO: Light or Inazuma Eleven GO: Shadow today – game on!
disclaimer:
The contents of the software are the same as the package version released on December 15, 2011 (price: 5,966 yen).
Due to the large amount of data, it may take a long time to download the software. Please download while charging your Nintendo 3DS.
